definitions.explanation: a surgical procedure to transfer an organ from a donor to a recipient

examples.japanese: {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}を{受|う}ける。
{日本|にほん}では{臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}のドナーが{不足|ふそく}している。
examples.english: In Japan, there is a shortage of organ transplant donors.

examples.japanese: {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}{法|ほう}の{改正|かいせい}により、{家族|かぞく}の{同意|どうい}があれば{本人|ほんにん}の{意思|いし}{表示|ひょうじ}がなくても{提供|ていきょう}が{可能|かのう}になった。
examples.english: With the revision of the Organ Transplant Law, donation became possible with family consent even without the individual's prior declaration of intent.

notes:
A medical and news term for the surgical transfer of organs from one person to another. Composed of {臓器|ぞうき} (organ) + {移植|いしょく} (transplant). Japan has historically had low rates of organ transplantation compared to Western countries, partly due to cultural attitudes toward brain death and bodily integrity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}を{受|う}ける — to receive an organ transplant
- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}{手術|しゅじゅつ} — organ transplant surgery
- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}{法|ほう} — Organ Transplant Law
- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}ドナー — organ transplant donor
- {臓器|ぞうき}{移植|いしょく}{待機|たいき}{者|しゃ} — person on the transplant waiting list

RELATED WORDS:
- {臓器|ぞうき}{提供|ていきょう} — organ donation
- {脳死|のうし} — brain death (a prerequisite for most organ donations)
- ドナーカード — donor card
- {拒絶反応|きょぜつはんのう} — rejection (immune response)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {移植|いしょく} — transplant (general; also used for bone marrow, skin, etc.)
- {骨髄|こつずい}{移植|いしょく} — bone marrow transplant
